summary.intent: Work through the callisto v1 plan: start parallel lanes of fixes, refactors and tests in separate worktrees, then settle the pending design decisions and build the decision-free and newly decided items (CI hygiene, E317, pre-mode, range hard-stop, dist-tag, dead-code removal, status warning).
summary.outcome: Opened and, for most, merged a long series of signed PRs (#202-#208, #270-#272 and further T06/W4 PRs), each gated by a passing local `just ci`. Decisions were recorded locally (lockstep versioning for all four published crates, OIDC post-1.0). The last W4 commit (status warning and failed-command tail) was being committed when the transcript ended.

repo: The plan and decision proposals live in git-excluded `.claude/plans/` (via `.git/info/exclude`); tracking and handoff files must never go in a commit or PR.

Every change runs `just ci` in its own worktree off `origin/main`, with a changeset for user-visible changes and updates to `docs/specs/*.json`, `docs/errors.md` and `docs/architecture` where behavior changes.
The wrapper's 'exit code 0' notification only reflects the script; the real result is the `exit=` line in the CI log (one run showed `exit=1` from fmt-check while the wrapper reported 0).

Callisto has four published crates (model, manifests, graph, cli) plus dev-only fixtures; they are in one fixed group (lockstep). `callisto-model` stays separate because it is MIT while the others are FSL.
Test fixtures with fake tools hid real bugs, so tests prefer the real binary and real tools (real `jq` in the napi roster test), and mutation checks prove tests can fail.
Reruns after a partial release rely on observing tag, registry and GitHub release state when the tag is on HEAD; a tag on an older commit settles the version without provider contact.
macOS bash in tests lacks `mapfile`; templates must use portable loops.
The dry-run report flattens the intent with envelope fields, and the intent omits `artifactSlots` when empty (jq `.artifactSlots[]` iterates null).
Scripted bulk edits (qualify/fixup scripts) altered unrelated comments (`cargo/npm/twine` in runner.rs); always review the staged diff.

code.finding: Tag observation used a for-each-ref format that errored on multi-paragraph tag messages; it now reads only the object type, since the spec says annotation text is never compared.

The large derive function was split into stage functions behind insta characterization snapshots, with `uploads_by_package` moved into `OpIndex`; a mutation dropping platform prerequisites was caught by the snapshots.
The napi roster is now derived per intent package via `callisto matrix` in the plan job's jq, and placement reads the plan job's `napi_dirs` output.

workflow: Write the failing reproduction first, then fix, and mutate the source to prove new tests can fail.
The sandbox rejects inline `env` commands, heredocs and some scripts mentioning `git`; write scripts or message files to the jobs tmp dir and run those.
Background sessions and the sandbox can only edit inside the current worktree, so cross-worktree edits require ExitWorktree/EnterWorktree.
Get an independent review of risky changes from a fresh agent; it found real issues on #202 (tag message parsing, a dependent tagged at HEAD with an untagged dependency).
Stacked PRs are linked with `gh stack`; heredoc PR bodies with escaped backticks render literal backslashes.

friction: PR #201 put the local-only NEXT-WORK.md plan in a PR; the user objected and it was closed.
The sandbox blocked inline env, heredoc and git-mentioning scripts, forcing script-file workarounds.
A macOS `sed` one-liner and `rg -E` flag failed, and output was silently dropped.
Three existing tests assumed a tag on HEAD means released, which is the SYS-RETRY defect, so they had to be rewritten.
Scripted conversion of bare config references double-prefixed some names and corrupted colon-form test inputs and comments.
The `errors.md` file conflicted on rebase across several stacked PRs and had to be resolved by hand.
The local plan file could not be edited from a background worktree session.
open_items: Delete stale branches (`docs/next-work-plan`, `docs/spec-rewrite`, `fix/native-resolution`, `docs/crate-consolidation-plan`, ~35 local branches), pending per-branch user confirmation.
W1 real-service credential check needs a decision on where it runs in CI; W11 verification needs credentials and an approved run.

T06 PR 5 (canonical ids in reports, schemaVersion 2 on four reports, remove `BareRuleMatchesMultipleEcosystems` variant), plus the remaining unstarted tasks (concurrency group for the simple workflow, A2 local route releasing HEAD, A5 foreign published version).
OIDC trusted publishing deferred to post-1.0; merging `callisto-manifests` into `callisto-graph` deferred until after 1.0.
cargo-semver-checks deferred until the promised stable surfaces (schema output, config and report formats) are chosen.
Update #204 and the plan for the T08-RETRY entries once #202 merges.
PR for the final W4 commit (status warning for inferred release without changeset, failed-command tail) still to be pushed and opened.
Independent review on riskier PRs and SYS-MATURIN/W9 remain blocked on D01 and other open decisions in section D of V1-REVIEW-2026-10-20.md.
